title: `executeCallback` call causes that ownership cannot be updated on the base chain
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  When `Beacon.triggerOwnershipUpdate()` is called, the new owners of the tokens are read from the target chain, and `Beacon._updateOwnership()` is executed on the source chain to update the ownership.  When this is executed on the NFT's native chain, `shadowAddress` is the address of the NFT contract, not the NFTShadow contract. As such, when `_shadow.executeCallback(guid)` is called at the end of the function, the transaction will revert, as the NFT contract does not have the `executeCallback` function.  ```solidity 564:
